comment: Initial baseline captured by EP-6 finalization. Run `node scripts/audit-empty-states.mjs --write-baseline` to refresh from a live AST sweep. The values below reflect a grep-level static survey (counts of `<Select(\s|>|/)` minus `<Select.Option>` occurrences vs `<SelectWithQuickCreate>` wrappers) across `frontend/src/**/*.tsx`. The CI `--check` mode treats `pendingFiles` as the ratchet: every PR must keep this number at or below the baseline.
